sentence.sentence: Regulation can be necessary to protect consumers.
sentence.translation: नियमन उपभोक्ताओं की रक्षा के लिए आवश्यक हो सकता है।

sentence.sentence: Stability is essential for economic growth.

words.definition: The ability to pay debts and meet financial obligations
